title: Atomic latency-budget fencing and backup-integrity safety net for scheduled passive-region promotions
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Objective: Define and validate an end-to-end operational playbook for scheduled active->passive promotion drills that enforces an atomic latency-budget fence and a backup-integrity safety net. This ticket scopes the runbook, preflight validation, automated checks, and post-drill verification to reduce risk when we rehearse regional promotions for SLO-bound inference traffic.
background: We run periodic failover drills for active/passive regions. Recent rehearsals show oscillations in token latency once traffic shifts to passive regions and occasional partial restores with minor KV drift. This playbook combines three orthogonal controls: 1) an atomic latency-budget fence (preventing promotion if 95th/99th latency budgets are already exhausted), 2) a backup-integrity verification step before ingress is allowed, and 3) TTL-driven load-shedding thresholds that gracefully degrade low-priority routes first.
scope: Scheduled drills for Redwood hosted inference for a single customer-facing region pair (us-west-2 primary / eu-west-1 passive). Includes: preflight checks, staged traffic ramp, circuit-breaker tuning, automated backup/restore verification, and a post-drill integrity audit. Excludes ad-hoc emergency failovers and Dedicated customer private deployments (separate playbook planned).
success_criteria: No more than 3% increase in 95th-percentile token latency vs baseline during steady-state ramp
All critical KV snapshots validate checksums and row counts within 0.01% of primary
Canary traffic (1% of requests) shows <1% error rate for 30 minutes after promote
Automated rollback triggers within 2 minutes of sustained SLO violations (5 minute window)
preflight_checks: Verify latest KV snapshot exists and is marked completed (S3 key: s3://redwood-backups/us-west-2/snapshots/YYYYMMDD-HHMM.tar.gz)
Run checksum-compare job against snapshot (script: ops/bin/checksum_compare.sh) and assert pass
Ensure passive region has healthy warm pool nodes >= min_capacity_percentage (config: 0.6)
Confirm model variant availability and quantization matches production model (console: ModelCatalog -> model-rt-v1)
Confirm circuit-breaker thresholds are set to pre-approved values for the drill (CB config id: cb/drill/2026-02)
Notify oncall and stakeholding PMs via PagerDuty/Slack and create ephemeral incident channel
staged_promotion_procedure: Phase 0: Lock - set routing policy to schedule-only for drill window; freeze automated rollouts
Phase 1: Verify - run preflight_checks and wait for green from checksum job and capacity probe
Phase 2: Canary - route 1% of traffic to passive region for 30 minutes, monitor latency/error budgets and KV read-after-write consistency metrics
Phase 3: Incremental ramp - double canary at 5 minute intervals up to target ramp (25% -> 50% -> 75% -> 100%), stop and evaluate after each step
Phase 4: Fence - enforce atomic latency-budget check prior to final 100% cutover; if 95th latency >= configured fence threshold then abort and rollback
Phase 5: Hold - once at 100%, hold for observation window (60 minutes) and run forensic keyspace checks
Phase 6: Revert - unwind promotion in reverse stages if rollback criteria met or keep promotion as drill-record if success criteria are met
circuit_breaker_and_load_shedding: Primary CB strategy: hierarchical CBs by route priority (critical, standard, background); only background routes shed first
CB thresholds are percentile-based and use sliding windows (e.g., open if 99th latency > 1200ms for 30s)
Secondary: token-rate based shedding anchored to per-model token budgets with soft and hard caps
Tertiary: TTL-driven shedding - cache TTLs shortened dynamically for non-critical routes to reduce KV pressure during promotion
Operational knobs: manual 'drill-safe' override that bypasses aggressive shedding for debug-only traffic (requires two SRE approvals)
backup_and_restore_validation: Snapshot verification: validate snapshot manifest, object checksums, and snapshot completeness
Restore dry-run: restore snapshot into an isolated test cluster in passive region and run smoke inference tests against golden prompts
KV reconciliation: run deterministic row-count and checksum comparison between restored cluster and live primary; allow max drift threshold 0.01%
Incremental WAL replay validation: ensure WAL replay completes without error and no skipped ops are detected
Automated artifact link: upload validation receipt to s3://redwood-dr-logs/YYYYMMDD/ENG-271905/validation.json
rollback_criteria: Sustained 99th-percentile latency above fence threshold for >120 seconds post-ramp
KV reconciliation shows drift >0.01% or checksum mismatch
Persistence errors (write failures to blobstore) are observed in passive region
Manual abort requested by oncall/lead engineer in incident channel
telemetry_and_alerting: Define SLOs used for drill: P99 token latency < 850ms, availability 99.95%
Create temporary dashboards: drill/ENG-271905 (Grafana) with latency histograms, cb states, kv-drift, restore-status
Alert rules: drill-critical (PagerDuty) on SLO breach, drill-warning (Slack) on CB opens >3 routes
Trace sampling: increase sampling for promoted region to 100% for 30 minutes after final ramp
Metric collection: persist bucketed latency and request counts to long-term storage for postmortem
runbook_checklist: Pre-drill: update console runbook link and attach snapshot manifest
During drill: assign roles - Runbook Lead, KV Validation, Traffic Lead, Oncall Liaison
Post-drill: generate validation artifacts, tag the drill in the release notes, and schedule postmortem within 72 hours
Communication: send customer-facing status update template if customer-facing endpoints were in scope
postmortem_template: Summary: short description of what happened and drill outcome
Timeline: ordered timestamps for each major step and observed metric changes
Root cause analysis: if rollbacks occurred, detailed explanation of triggering conditions
Action items: prioritized list with owners and due dates
Metrics appendix: pre/post baseline SLO numbers, KV-drift reports, dashboard links
deliverables: A versioned runbook in Confluence (link below)
Automation scripts for preflight snapshot checks and checksum_compare.sh improvements
Grafana dashboard and temporary alert rules for the drill
Post-drill verification artifact uploaded to S3 and linked in the ticket
